**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 02:09
- [USER] User inquired about "jump cancel" in Cars speedrunning and how to perform it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jump Cancel is a technique used in Cars speedrunning that allows the player to maintain their speed when transitioning from a driving section to a flying section.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jump Cancel is commonly used in the "Boostin' with Fillmore" and "Sarge's Off-Road Challenge" levels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To perform a Jump Cancel, the player must first build up speed on the ground.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The player must jump into the air.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] While in mid-air, the player must switch to the flying mode.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The player must immediately switch back to the driving mode.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Jump Cancel cancels the jump animation and allows the car to maintain its speed while transitioning back to driving mode.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It may take some practice to get the timing right.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mastering the Jump Cancel technique can save valuable seconds during speedruns.
